title: Manifest or update checks in request path
summary: Extension code performs remote update checks or manifest reads during normal page rendering.
rationale: Update and metadata checks in hot paths add latency and external network dependence.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Run update checks on schedule or admin-only flows, and cache results with sane TTLs.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
